overall_reason: The site reads with scripts off, but lab LCP is 6.4 s with gallery images served at five times their size, and the phone headings sit nowrap in a 165px column with no room for a longer word.

score.reason: T-NO-SCRIPT passes; T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB fails (ROB-018, LCP 6360 ms), T-HOSTILE-CONTENT fails on the phone headings (ROB-005) and T-LAYOUT-SHIFT on the display face (ROB-017).

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.where: Home gallery images (ln-home-horiz-*.webp) and page load, all widths
findings.evidence: The sweep's performance hits (WEB-001): lab LCP 6360 ms (fail over 4500) and 1440px-wide images shown at 251 to 317px (4.5 to 5.7 times). performance: 121 requests (fail), 198 image entries; bytes are known for only 2 of 121 requests.
findings.before: The gallery serves one 1440px file to every slot, including the small offset photos.
findings.after: Serve each gallery image with srcset and sizes matched to its slot, and give the hero a light poster that paints first.
findings.why: Fans arrive on phones; a 6.4 s lab LCP means seconds of empty screen on a real mobile line.
findings.root: one image size for every slot

findings.title: Long and unbroken text reflows
findings.where: Section headings (div.title-headline-w h2: 'HELMETS / HALL OF FAME', 'PARTNERS / &CAMPAIGNS', 'WORLD DRIVERS' CHAMPION'), 375px, tiles/375-06.png and tiles/375-09.png
findings.evidence: text_risk.nowrap_clipped: '&campaigns' in a 165px box clipped by 164px, 'Hall of Fame' 165px box clipped by 164px, 'Champion' clipped by 424px, all nowrap with no ellipsis; the clipping comes from the line masks of the reveal animation. On tiles/375-09.png '&CAMPAIGNS' already fills the left column and touches the paragraph beside it, and 'CHAMPION' runs from x 13 to 185.
findings.before: Display headings set nowrap in a half-width column beside the paragraph on phones.
findings.after: Below 480px stack the heading above its paragraph, and allow it to wrap (white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word).
findings.why: Reasoned, not observed: a longer word (a new partner category, a translated title) has no room and will run under the paragraph or be cut by the mask.

findings.title: Loading never moves what the visitor is reading
findings.where: Display face 'Brier Bold' on the large headings, all widths
findings.evidence: css.font_face: 3 faces, metric_overrides 0, one face with font-display not set and two with swap. fonts.json shows 'Brier Bold' drawing the large headline words (408 glyphs) inside 'Mona Sans' stacks.
findings.before: The large display words swap from Arial to Brier Bold with no metric overrides.
findings.after: Add size-adjust, ascent-override and descent-override to the display face, or preload it.
findings.why: The biggest words on the page reflow when the font lands; layout shift was not measured in this capture.

strengths: The page reads with scripts off: 1533 visible characters, the same share as the baseline, and no hidden-content hits.
The document matches every viewport width; 90 aspect-ratio rules hold the image slots.
Phone and desktop show the same text (no parity loss).
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long names, translations and missing images are reasoned from layout evidence, not observed
right-to-left render: not captured; readiness read from the stylesheet only
page load on a throttled line: only actions were held slow
layout shift as a number: this capture predates CLS recording
computed text-overflow per element: absent in this capture; ellipsis rows come from class rules and were checked on tiles
widths between the captures, 320px and landscape
regions behind menus, tabs, dialogs or a login that the capture did not open
T-FAILURE-PATH and T-SLOW-LINE: async was not captured (--no-async)
true page weight: bytes known for 2 of 121 requests
T-LOCALE-FORMAT: no dates, money or units found
